10: function parseSimpleYaml(input: string): Frontmatter {
11:   const data: Frontmatter = {};
12:   for (const line of input.split(/\r?\n/)) {
13:     const separator = line.indexOf(':');
14:     if (separator < 0) continue;
15:     const key = line.slice(0, separator).trim();
16:     if (!key) continue;
17:     let value = line.slice(separator + 1).trim();
18:     if ((value.startsWith('"') && value.endsWith('"')) || (value.startsWith("'") && value.endsWith("'"))) value = value.slice(1, -1);
19:     if (value.startsWith('[') && value.endsWith(']')) data[key] = value.slice(1, -1).split(',').map((tag) => tag.trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '')).filter(Boolean);
20:     else data[key] = value;
21:   }
22:   return data;
23: }

25: export function parseMarkdown(source: string): ParsedMarkdown {
26:   let yaml: Frontmatter = {};
27:   let markdown = source;
28:   const match = source.match(/^---\s*\r?\n([\s\S]*?)\r?\n---\s*(?:\r?\n|$)/);
29:   if (match) {
30:     yaml = parseSimpleYaml(match[1]);
31:     markdown = source.slice(match[0].length);
32:   }
33:   const parsed = matter(markdown);
34:   return { data: { ...parsed.data, ...yaml } as Frontmatter, content: parsed.content };
35: }

37: async function markdownFiles(directory: string, relative = ''): Promise<string[]> {

42:     if (entry.isDirectory()) files.push(...await markdownFiles(directory, child));
43:     else if (markdownExtensions.has(path.extname(entry.name).toLowerCase())) files.push(child);
44:   }
